summary: Ergo is an IRCv3 server implemented in Go that integrates traditional daemon functions, network services, and bouncer capabilities into a single binary. It manages real-time text communication channels and client connections according to modern Internet Relay Chat specifications. The software is distributed under the MIT licence.
goodFor: Self-hosters who want to run a lightweight, consolidated chat infrastructure without managing separate services and bouncer daemons.
watchOut: Adopters may face a smaller community and fewer troubleshooting resources compared to older, more established IRC servers like InspIRCd or UnrealIRCd.
deployNotes: Since it is packaged for Docker and written in Go, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for state data and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
